sentences.text: John Healey will remove import taxes on marmalade, gherkins and more than 100 products in a move to give families "breathing space" with the cost of living in the Budget .
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: On Wednesday the chancellor will promise a fresh series of "everyday fixes" to ease the pressure on households.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: The measures will also include an end to the so-called cliff-edge for those receiving carer's allowance payments and higher tax-free mileage rates being made permanent.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: But the Conservatives said the offer of "cheaper gherkins" was "an insult to families hammered by Labour's tax rises".
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: Ahead of the Budget, the government said it is removing tariffs on more than 100 "family favourite" products, while supporting farmers facing higher fertiliser costs and households reliant on heating oil.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: It says the changes could save households up to £21 per year when combined with existing tariff suspensions on products including pasta, fruit juice and tuna.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: Healey's Budget needs to sustain the stronger economy through gathering clouds Marmalade, for example, will see a 20% tariff, plus an additional £19 charge per 100kg imported, suspended.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: Healey said that the ongoing wars in Iran and Ukraine had "hit families here at home through higher everyday costs".
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: "We can't control global events, but we can act where we can make a difference," he added.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: As first reported in The Sun, the 5p duty discount is also set to continue.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: That discount was first introduced in 2022, and was due to last 12 months, but has been extended ever since.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said: "We are taking on the big challenges facing the country.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: But that doesn't mean losing sight of the everyday problems that cost people money or simply aren't fair.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: Shadow chancellor Andrew Griffith said: "Shoppers face rising costs at the till and families are struggling to make ends meet, but Burnham's plan is cheaper gherkins.
sentences.article_title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help

sentences.text: This is an insult to families hammered by Labour's tax rises."

sentences.text: Rapper Jay-Z will perform at the Super Bowl half-time show in February, the NFL has announced.
sentences.article_title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show

sentences.text: Jay-Z's company Roc Nation has produced the half-time show since 2019, and he plays a key role in selecting each year's performer.
sentences.article_title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show

sentences.text: But the hip-hop mogul has not previously performed himself at the NFL championship game, and the announcement did not specify if he would be the sole headliner.
sentences.article_title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show

sentences.text: "Anticipation as to who Jay-Z might have guest star at halftime for the big game will now kick off," the NFL said in a statement.
sentences.article_title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show

sentences.text: "Of course, his wife, Beyoncé, will be atop the list." Next year's Super Bowl LXI will take place on 14 February near Los Angeles.

sentences.text: Around 22,000 properties are still without power as parts of Scotland and north England were battered by Storm Boelo over the weekend.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: A clean-up operation is under way in parts of the UK after Storm Boelo caused flooding and property damage, leaving thousands without power.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: The Energy Networks Association (ENA) said around 22,600 properties were still without power as of Monday afternoon.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: Two men were killed by falling trees during the storm on Sunday - a man in his 20s whose car was hit in north London and a 60-year-old man in Dumfries and Galloway identified as Richard Baines , the long-serving curator of Logan Botanic Garden.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: A yellow warning for strong winds came in effect at 18:00 on Monday across the west coast of England, Wales and Scotland and eastern parts of Northern Ireland and will last until 03:00 on Tuesday.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: The Met Office has warned that further power cuts in areas covered by the warning are likely and people should make sure they have essentials prepared, including torches and batteries.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: Coastal communities could also be affected by spray or large waves, while travel delays are expected.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: Boelo is the second storm to have hit parts of the UK in recent days, following Storm Austen.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: Leo Slade, CEO of the ENA said it had been "a tough weekend" and that efforts to reconnect some properties were being hampered by the weather, with sustained winds of 50-85mph across parts of Scotland and northern England.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: "Until that weather system passes, we can't safely get engineers out to replace poles, to get wires back up, so today is going to be a hive of activity in getting engineers out into the field," Slade told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: He stressed that the UK's power network was very resilient and money was spent to prepare for these sorts of scenarios, but said a debate was needed over how much more investment was required to mitigate for further storms brought by climate change.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: Storm Boelo clears but more wind and rain bears down on UK Marcus Reed, the operations director at a home fragrance manufacturer, said his factory and shop in Lyndal, Cumbria would be without power until Tuesday evening.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: He told the Today programme that he has had to turn away employees and customers.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: "To lose two days manufacturing and distribution is going to be really disruptive," he said, adding that it was bad timing as it was "the busiest time of the year" for his business in the lead-up to Christmas.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: "This is probably the worst situation I've experienced in my time here; we've had ad hoc issues over weekends where we've lost power, but it's been contained within a 12-hour period.
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: It's the first time anything like this has happened, it's very serious." Wendy McKinney, whose bathroom shop in the seaside town of Largs in North Ayrshire was flooded on Sunday, told the Today programme the storm had been "devastating to local businesses".
sentences.article_title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning

sentences.text: A spokesperson said council teams "followed established resilience procedures" but would review flooding reports and "consider any lessons that can be learned".

sentences.text: Monday morning saw rain in many parts of south-west England, Wales and Northern Ireland, which moved north-eastwards reaching central, eastern and northern England, as well as most of Scotland, by around lunchtime.

sentences.text: John meticulously planned the handover of household admin before his death Louisa Nicoll knew her husband John was going to die about a year before it happened.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: The couple used the time to make memories with their children, James and Amy, and John meticulously organised their paperwork.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: But despite him asking for accounts to be switched to Louisa's name, she still received post addressed to him after his death.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: In one letter from their energy provider, it said: "Sorry you're leaving us.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: Is there anything we can do to make you stay?" "I felt utterly exhausted, overwhelmed, frustrated and angry because of those experiences," she told BBC's Morning Live.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: Louisa now campaigns for changes in the way companies deal with admin after someone dies and offers advice on how talking about death before it happens can help families cope afterwards.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: After their father's death, James and Amy still received texts from their mobile phone provider that read "Hi, John" John was 50 and working as a police surveillance trainer when he was diagnosed with cancer.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: Louisa had a career in palliative care nursing and was a ward manager in a hospice.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: John underwent nine major surgeries and four rounds of chemotherapy - working full-time through it all.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "He absolutely loved working with his supportive police colleagues, and he cherished everyday family life and spending time with our friends," says Louisa.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: When further surgery was no longer an option, palliative chemotherapy was offered.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: Following many discussions, John decided to focus on making memories as a husband, dad and friend rather than spending his final months as a patient.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "He made a lovely speech at Amy's 18th birthday," she says.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "We visited family in Scotland and had planned a family holiday to Greece - but Covid hit and we had a Greek night at home instead." The couple had a party for Louisa's 50th and their 25th wedding anniversary.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: John wrote Louisa an 18-page document called "things to make you smile" In the background, John was busy compiling a handover of the household admin.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "He even wrote a plan for me titled 'things you need to know', packed with every household account, insurance renewal and MOT dates," she says.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: He had emailed their energy provider saying he would like Louisa to take over as the account holder due to his terminal diagnosis.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: But instead, she was added as an additional name and had to close and reopen the account.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "I thought I was prepared for John's death but the reality was so much harder than I could ever have imagined.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: He really was the other half of me.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: So when I had to face the death admin, I felt so vulnerable without him beside me." James and Amy's mobile phone contracts were in John's name, too.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: They were asked to take his death certificate into a store but still received texts that read "Hi, John".
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "I'm sure nobody's doing this intentionally... but these companies could just get their bereavement services at a level that is not going to cause undue distress," says Louisa.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "There should be a standardised practice." Louisa urges families regardless of age to have conversations and make end-of-life plans Sarah Middlemiss, policy campaigns manager at end-of-life charity Marie Curie, tells Morning Live admin tasks can be particularly difficult when you are grieving.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "And because every company does things in a slightly different way and requires slightly different things, it can be really, really overwhelming," she says.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "Proper training on how to deal with people who are grieving or who are terminally ill in a really sensitive and timely manner would go a really long way." John and Louisa at a family wedding before his diagnosis Louisa gives talks at events to encourage people to talk about death in advance.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "We plan for every major event in life - weddings, pregnancy, career changes, retirement, even our meals each day - yet most people leave the end of life completely to chance," she says.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "Our families end up trapped in a crisis - guessing our wishes in the back of an ambulance or a chaotic A&E department." She says she and John had those "hard but important conversations" long before they needed them.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: Louisa says John kept his sense of humour and personality throughout his treatment John died peacefully at home in August 2020, just one day after their 26th wedding anniversary.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: "Before he died, we spoke about what I would do for work after he died.
sentences.article_title: My husband's death was hard enough - then came the admin

sentences.text: He said, 'I think you'll tell our story, and show people that it is possible to live well when faced with dying.' And that is what I'm trying to do." sentences.text: Lula's supporters mobilised en masse despite polls pointing to a defeat for the incumbent A WhatsApp channel created to support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign is being credited by allies with helping deliver one of the most unlikely comebacks in recent Brazilian politics.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Brazil's left-wing president had been trailing right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro, but managed to turn the race around in just three weeks.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: At a moment when many doubted Lula could reverse the result, a WhatsApp channel called Lula's Army emerged, and rapidly grew to 10.8 million followers.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Led by Congressman André Janones, the operation encouraged supporters to share videos, promote hashtags and recruit new voters.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Its dramatic growth between the two rounds was particularly notable because it appeared to reverse a long-standing imbalance in Brazilian politics.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: For years, conservatives aligned with former President Jair Bolsonaro had been widely seen as dominating online political mobilisation, especially on platforms such as WhatsApp and Telegram.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Lula called André Janones "our General" after his major contribution paid off The emergence of Lula's Army convinced many supporters that Brazil's left had finally found a way to compete in a digital arena.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: The shift was particularly significant because social media has played a central role in Brazilian politics since Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 election victory, when WhatsApp networks became a defining feature of political campaigning.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Lula's Army messages often included ready-made templates for followers to share with friends and family.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Each one assigned supporters a specific task aimed at boosting Lula's visibility on social media.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Janones frequently instructed his "troops" to "blow up" the latest campaign video or help a new hashtag "take off".
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "Guys, urgent!", "Don't go to sleep yet", "No food before the mission!", and "I have one more task before you're dismissed", were some of the instructions.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: On the eve of the election, the congressman also hosted a 24-hour live event - dubbed the "turnaround livestream" - even as polls continued to suggest a victory for Bolsonaro.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: The tactic worked, despite worries by some members of the Workers' Party that Janones's often-confrontational style on social media could undermine the more moderate image they hoped to project for Lula.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: In his victory speech, Lula referred to Janones as "our General" and thanked him for "raising the morale of our troops every day".
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Measuring the electoral impact of online mobilisation, however, is notoriously difficult.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: While Lula's allies credit Lula's Army with helping fuel the comeback, political scientists caution that it is impossible to determine how many votes, if any, were directly influenced by the WhatsApp operation.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Political scientist Denilde Holzhacker argues that a shift in Lula's campaign strategy was key to his comeback.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Rather than relying solely on online engagement, she says the Workers' Party candidate succeeded in connecting digital campaigning with grassroots mobilisation on the ground.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: According to Holzhacker, the campaign intensified local efforts and adapted its messaging - linking a Bolsonaro victory with concerns about potential changes to social programmes and the loss of rights.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "It was to Lula's credit that he recognised his own weakness and completely changed his style," she says.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "And Janones managed to do something that had seemed unthinkable for Brazil's left - dominate social media." By contrast, Holzhacker argues that Flávio Bolsonaro entered the run-off overly confident of victory and failed to communicate his message to his supporters as effectively.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Sociologist and political scientist Mayra Goulart, a professor at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro, also cautions against attributing Lula's comeback solely to social media.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "It was a combination of social media and street-level mobilisation," she says.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "The physical world enabled a form of mobilisation capable of reducing abstention and persuading undecided voters." In her view, Lula's supporters succeeded in turning online enthusiasm into real-world political engagement.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "Those committed to Lula's victory worked to bring people together and persuade them to vote," Goulart says.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: She argues that the effort not only helped increase turnout but could also prove valuable for Lula's next administration.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "I believe this collective effort was an important learning experience and will prove valuable for a government that still faces many battles ahead.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: It not only helped reduce abstention, but also converted a significant number of undecided voters." Lula himself suggested that the mobilisation behind his comeback could shape the way he governs in the years ahead.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: In his victory speech, he said the election had taught him many lessons and pledged to change the way Brazil is governed.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "We are going to give people a greater say in decision-making, and digital communication will play a much bigger role in my government." sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: The 18-year-old student was fatally stabbed in Southampton in December by Vickrum Digwa, who falsely claimed he had been racially abused and had acted in self-defence.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: Digwa was jailed for life on 1 June, with a minimum term of 21 years.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: Following the teenager's murder, police bodycam footage of him being handcuffed as he lay dying led to intense scrutiny of the Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary and sparked wider debates around knife laws, race, policing and public trust.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: The review, which was welcomed by Nowak's family, will be led by former Justice Secretary Alex Chalk KC.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: "We must get to truth of what happened before, during and after that awful night and we must do everything in our power to ensure that no family suffers the same fate," Mahmood told the House of Commons on Monday.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: Mahmood said the review will investigate what was known about Nowak's killer and if there were missed opportunities to intervene as well as the treatment of his family in the justice system and whether they received enough support.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: In a statement published on Monday, the Home Office said the review will be carried out in two parts.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: Phase one will cover the police, health services, local authorities educational institutions and faith organisations, including if any concerns were raised relating to weapon possession and violent behavior, the statement said.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: It will also look to determine if there were missed opportunities to prevent Nowak's murder.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: Phase two will follow after the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) has concluded its investigation into the actions of police officers who attended the scene.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: It will consider the actions of the IOPC and "if necessary" the police, the Home Office added.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: The IOPC launched its own investigation into the response on the night of Nowak's death after bodycam footage showed the 18-year-old was handcuffed and left dying on the floor despite informing officers of his injuries.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: The investigation was launched despite a sentencing judge ruling Nowak would not have survived his injuries, however quickly he received treatment.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: The Nowak family described the announcement as a "significant moment in our fight for justice." "We hope this review, alongside the ongoing investigations and inquest, will finally uncover the full truth and deliver the accountability and meaningful change we have fought so hard for," they added in a statement.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: "Our experience of the criminal justice system has been deeply disappointing, and we are determined that no other family should have to endure what we have." Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch welcomed the decision to launch the review.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: "There must be proper accountability for those who failed Henry and his family," she said.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: The review is due to report in five months.
sentences.article_title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak

sentences.text: Justyna Hulboj, 27, and her four-year-old daughter Lena Czepczor were killed on Scott Hall Road in Leeds in January 2023 Two men who killed a mother and her four-year-old daughter as they raced their high-performance cars along a Leeds city centre road have been jailed.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: Justyna Hulboj, 27, and her daughter Lena Czepczor were killed when they were hit by an Audi TT RS as they walked to the girl's nursery on the A61 Scott Hall Road on 16 January 2023.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: At Leeds Crown Court on Monday, Hardeep Bhachu, 29, was jailed for 12 years and Jasskamal Riyat, 37, for 16 years.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: Sentencing the men, Judge Singh said the road was "not a race track" and told them the deaths had consequences that were "immeasurable", with an "immense" impact on those left behind.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: Bhachu, of Grant Row in Adel, had earlier admitted two counts of causing death by dangerous driving , while Riyat, of Buckstone Avenue in Moortown, was convicted by a jury after denying he had been racing him.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: The court heard the pair, who did not previously know each other, accelerated away from traffic lights on Scott Hall Road shortly before the crash.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: Prosecutors said Riyat's BMW reached speeds of up to 89mph in the 40mph zone before Bhachu lost control of his Audi, mounted the pavement and struck Hulboj and her daughter.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: Hardeep Bhachu and Jasskamal Riyat were sentenced at Leeds Crown Court Judge Singh said the victims had "done nothing wrong" and were "simply walking to school".
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: Addressing the defendants, he said: "A road is not a race track.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: A powerful car is not an invitation to test its limits on a public road.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: "The consequences of competitive driving at extreme speed can be, and in this case were, irreversible." He added: "Justyna and Lena should have gone to school that morning.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: They should have returned home.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: They should have continued with their lives.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: She said he "must live with himself in the knowledge of the devastation he has caused".
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: And she said: "He did not intend to cause this devastation but cause it he has." Hulboj's fiancé Dominik Czepczor watched the sentencing hearing in court.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: A statement from him was read, which said: "My whole world collapsed in one second.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: "Every day I feel a huge void after their departure.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: "We had so many hopes and dreams and in one moment it all ended.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: "My dream was to have a wonderful family, and I must say that it came true for a short while, but that was taken away from me on January 16.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: "This sentencing hearing though does mark the end of a long criminal justice process for Justyna and Lena's family.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: "It is over two years since Bhachu admitted his part in this tragic incident and I know that the wait for justice has taken its toll.
sentences.article_title: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed

sentences.text: Americans have gone all in on "maxxing", making it the 2026 Word of the Year for Dictionary.com.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Short for maximising, the term "can be used on its own or added to the end of any word to convey you're doing something to the fullest or optimizing it as much as possible", Dictionary.com said in a statement.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: It's a major departure from two years ago, when the site, after analysing US social media trends, news stories, and search data, chose demure as word of the year.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: "Maxxing is the linguistic manifestation of a culture increasingly preoccupied with getting the most out of everything," said Steve Johnson, director of lexicography for the Dictionary Media Group.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Digital media used "maxxing" nearly 19 times more in August 2026 compared to the 2025 monthly average, Dictionary.com found.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: The site also considered affordability, data centre, odyssey, and the shortened form of uncle, "unc", as potential words of the year.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: On social media, many people in Generation Z and younger - those under 30 - post extensively about their maxxing efforts to achieve all sorts of perfection.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Influencers focused on fitness and wellness post about "proteinmaxxing" and "fibermaxxing".
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Those giving their full attention to improving  sleep habits say they are "sleepmaxxing".
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: The influencer Clavicular has gained thousands of followers as he chronicles his extreme "looksmaxxing" - working to meet a set of prescribed criteria for attractiveness, with particular importance given to jawlines, eyes and physique.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: "Whatever we're doing, we want to push it further," Johnson said.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: "But its expanding uses also reveal how people are responding to that impulse.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Some exaggerate it for laughs.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Others subvert it entirely to describe stepping back from the relentless pursuit of more." People were playing with the term - and idea - for decades before Clavicular started posting videos.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: In the opening song for the 1990s television show The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air, for example, Will Smith raps: "Chillin' out, maxin', relaxin' all cool." "Unfortunately, by the time the dictionary gets a hold of it, that probably means that it's reached critical mass," says teacher Lauren Cella.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Cella, a content creator known for her viral Gen Z history lessons, says she and her students have been using "maxxing" for some time as a suffix.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: "They're actually, in their own way, reinventing grammar, which I think is super cool," she says.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Maxxing gives the students permission to "optimise to meet a goal" or do something others might think of as "cringe", and allows them to own it, she says.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: "It's a fun, harmless way that kids are expressing themselves and sharing different goals that they have," she says.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Linguist Vanessa Croft, who teaches English, says the internet and digital media make language move at "warp speed", even faster than radio, film or television ever did.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: As swiftly as new terms are added to the lexicon, they can just as quickly fall out of favour.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: "By the time millennials and Gen X or Gen Y start using the terms, Gen Z and Gen Alpha aren't using those terms anymore," she says.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: While she and her secondary-school aged students are still "maxxing" too,  they are now using it "almost ironically", she says.
sentences.article_title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

sentences.text: Diane Forsythe said "profound consequences" pledged over the Sinn Féin vice-president's handling of the Drumcree parading dispute "must be honoured".

sentences.text: Lockhart last week stepped down from the DUP's officer board in response to party leader Gavin Robinson not removing their deputy first minister to force O'Neill from the joint office.

sentences.text: It follows unionist anger over the first minister's involvement in protests on the Garvaghy Road , which blocked a contentious Orange Order parade from passing along the mainly nationalist street in Portadown, County Armagh.

sentences.text: O'Neill and several other senior Sinn Féin figures have been interviewed by police investigating the demonstrations, with unionists accusing the party of acting unlawfully.

sentences.text: The report's author Dr Robert Jones says there is a lack of debate about finding a solution to the problem of drug-related deaths More than a third of deaths of former prisoners on probation in Wales in a year were drug related, according to a new report.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The Wales Governance Centre at Cardiff University,  which has published the report, is urging politicians to tackle "systematic failures" in the criminal justice system.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The deaths figure is higher than the proportion recorded across England and Wales as a whole, where deaths in this category accounted for just over a fifth of the total.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Report author Dr Robert Jones called on the UK and Welsh governments to find a solution to the "tragic" situation.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The Welsh government said it was working to reduce "harms caused by substance misuse".
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The UK government said it was spending £3.4m on services to help support prison leavers overcome addiction.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: According to the report, 37% of all deaths among prison leavers supervised by probation in Wales in 2024-25 were drug related.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The number of drug poisonings where the intent was "undetermined" in Wales accounted for 19 of the 52 who died.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Jones said this was "substantially higher" than the proportion across England and Wales as a whole, where deaths in this same category accounted for just over a fifth (21%) of the total - 131 out of 620.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Criminal justice in Wales is controlled by Westminster.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The Plaid Cymru Welsh government, and the previous Labour administration in Cardiff before it, argue it should be devolved.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Speaking to BBC Wales, Jones said the research looked at UK government data including Freedom of Information requests.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: He said: "The added shock value to this is that these data point towards some systematic failures with incredibly tragic circumstances and consequences.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: "So what tends to happen is that criminal justice matters can often fall between the gaps between debates in the Senedd and debates in Westminster," he added.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Jones said the report raised "important questions about the current devolution settlement and whether the Welsh government has the powers and levers necessary to address the underlying causes of many of the challenges facing Wales".
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: "Housing, health and justice need a joined-up approach," he said.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: He said the charity supported "conversations to devolve justice and policing" and said without "coordinated" support prison leavers were "being set up to fail".
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: "The war on drugs hasn't worked," he added.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The report also says homelessness among former prisoners in Wales is continuing to rise.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: The number of people leaving prison, supervised by Welsh probation services, who were recorded as rough sleeping on the day of their release rose by 24% in 2025-26.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: In total, 695 prison leavers managed by Welsh probation services were rough sleeping on the day of their release.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Other findings include that more than a third (39%) of all custodial sentences given to women in Wales in 2025 were for offences related to thefts from shops.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Meanwhile, people from black ethnic groups in Wales remained the most overrepresented ethnic group in the prison population in 2025.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: There were 58 black people from Wales in prison for every 10,000 of the population, compared with 15 white people per 10,000 of the population.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: A spokesperson for the Welsh government said: "Every drug-related death is a tragedy.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: "Bringing responsibility for justice into line" with devolved services "would enable a more effective and joined-up approach to improving outcomes, reducing reoffending and building safer communities across Wales", the spokesperson added.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: A Ministry of Justice spokesperson said: "We inherited prisons in crisis but we're acting on all fronts, including by reducing the number of women in custody through investment in community services and cutting the flow of drugs into prisons.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: "In Wales we invest more than £3.4m into services which work across prisons, probation and courts to help support prison leavers overcome their addiction." They added that prisoners at risk of becoming homeless can be offered temporary accommodation by the prison and probation service.
sentences.article_title: More than third of deaths of ex-prisoners on probation drug related, says report

sentences.text: Second Lt Max George had exited the armoured vehicle when he was struck, an inquest heard An Army officer died when a Warrior armoured vehicle with a broken safety alarm was reversed into him, an inquest has been told.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: Second Lt Max George, 26, of Durham, died at the scene of a training exercise on Salisbury Plain, Wiltshire, on 21 June 2022.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: The ongoing inquest at Wiltshire and Swindon Coroner's Court heard an alarm, which was designed to alert the driver when the Warrior's rear doors were open, had been faulty since 2018.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: Lt Col Graham Watson, who led a service inquiry into the incident, said the driver of the Warrior "would have almost certainly stopped" if the alarm had sounded.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: Much-loved community pub on track to reopen Frustration as months of roadworks begin Theatres at risk and fighting back across the West Members of 5 Rifles got up at 05:00 BST on the day of the incident and left their barracks at 07:00, the inquest heard.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: They were undertaking an exercise called Combat Spirit, which formed the final part of four courses to qualify for Armoured Infantry.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: The inquest heard two groups of soldiers had converged on a target and 2nd Lt George was ordered to leave the Warrior through a rear door and take command on the ground.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: "[Second] Lt George exited the vehicle and was seen momentarily struggling either with a day sack or trying to free a radio antenna, which may have snagged," Col Watson said.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: The inquest took place at Wiltshire and Swindon Coroner's Court The armoured vehicle was stationary for between 38 and 43 seconds after the collision, the inquest heard, as soldiers shouted "wait" and horns sounded.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: A stop call was sent at 10:25, which halted the exercise.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: A built-in alarm system, which would have sounded a noise and shown a light to indicate the rear doors were open, did not work as a wire was broken, the inquest was told.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: Col Watson said: "The built-in alarm would have alarmed because the rear doors were open, and had that gone off the driver would have almost certainly stopped." Alarms had been installed on Warriors after two fatal incidents in the 1990s.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: Col Watson said several faults with the armoured vehicles were known about, but he told the inquest that these had not meant the vehicle should have been taken out of service.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: The inquest also heard the FV-511model involved in the incident was not ordinarily used for disembarking troops and close combat.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: "The student commander had done the majority of his training on the FV-510, which is the platoon variant of the vehicle," Col Watson said.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: "In general, the crew and service personnel within 5 Rifles were not that familiar with the FV-511 and its differences with the FV-510." A pen portrait was read out by 2nd Lt George's mother, Vivienne, during the hearing.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: She described her son as "modest and great fun" and said he would "quietly" fundraise through events like the Great North Run and Royal British Legion street collections.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: Second Lt George had won the Queen's Medal for best cadet when he passed out from the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst, the inquest was told.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: He had also attended Durham School, earned a first in politics with Russian at Newcastle University and obtained a Distinction in his Masters in Eastern European and Eurasian Studies with Russian at the University of Glasgow.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: His mother continued: "Max had effortless leadership qualities and his potential was enormous," she said.
sentences.article_title: Army officer killed by reversing Warrior with faulty alarm - inquest

sentences.text: Consultant doctors in England are to stage a two-day strike next month in a dispute over pay and working conditions.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: The walkout will begin on 25 November at 06:59 GMT, with consultants staffing emergency care only.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: This is known as Christmas Day cover and is likely to have a major impact on most routine and elective or planned services.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: The announcement comes after talks had been taking place with the government over the past month, following the vote in favour of strike action by British Medical Association members in July.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: Consultants – the most senior doctors in hospitals – were given a 3.5% pay increase this year.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: But the BMA argues pay has fallen by a quarter over the past 17 years, once inflation is taken into account.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: The union also wants a reduction in the standard working week, from 40 to 35 hours, and higher pay for out-of-hours work, alongside changes to pensions, including greater flexibility over when they can be taken.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: In a joint statement, BMA consultants committee co-chairs Dr Helen Neary and Dr Shanu Datta, said they had tried to negotiate with the government in "good faith", but "time-and-time again ministers have kicked the can down the road".
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: "Unfortunately, that road has now run out, and we have been forced to announce strikes.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: "Consultants take their responsibilities incredibly seriously, and striking does not come naturally, but we are hearing loud and clear from the profession that they have had enough." Average earnings for consultants top £150,000 a year.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: Basic pay starts at £113,500, with the most experienced getting £150,500.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: But many earn tens of thousands in extra payments and awards.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: In the strike ballot, 76% of consultants who took part voted in favour of strike action, with just over half of eligible BMA members taking part.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: The government says this represents only around one in five consultants employed by the NHS in England voting for strike action, as nearly half are not BMA members.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: Health Secretary Yvette Cooper said the government had been in "constructive discussions" with the BMA so it was "disappointing" the strike dates had been announced.
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: She said taking strike action would be "irresponsible" and "place the health service under even greater pressure".
sentences.article_title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month

sentences.text: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has become a key figure in the current AI era.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) firm Anthropic just released the required paperwork ahead of its long-anticipated debut on the US stock market.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: The 335-page document included fresh details of how the Claude chatbot owner makes money, what it spends that money on and who it is controlled by.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic also detailed some of the the risks it claimed AI technology poses, including how it could take human lives.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: That information sat alongside the many purported benefits of the technology.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Here are five key points worth highlighting from the filing.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Every public company has to tell potential investors how things could go wrong.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic's "risk factors" were unique, also disclosing how the AI technology it is developing could doom humanity as a whole.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: "Sufficiently advanced AI systems could, if not developed, deployed, and operated with appropriate safeguards, oversight, and security measures, pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity," Anthropic said.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: It noted that less than a year ago, a hacking group Anthropic believed to be sponsored by China "manipulated" Claude to successfully intrude on a number of institutions, including large technology companies, financial institutions, chemical manufacturing companies and government agencies.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: But Anthropic said its success is dependent on its ability to constantly "develop, improve, and deploy the most advanced, capable, and useful AI models".
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: One of the most significant risks to that ability is Anthropic's access to infrastructure it needs, including computer chips and data centres, to build, train and operate the models that underpin its technology.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic has yet to disclose a target share price for its stock listing.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: The company is widely expected to debut with a market valuation of $2 trillion or more, making it the largest stock listing in history.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: But the figure will be heavily influenced by its financial performance.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic lost $80.7bn (£60bn) in the first half of this year, double what it lost across 2025 altogether.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: The company's overall revenue was $16.2bn billion for the six-month period.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Revenues are rising rapidly, but the firm has a long way to go before it breaks even.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Troy Hooper, co-head of equity capital markets at Mergermarket, said Anthropic's revenue growth is "exceptional".
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: But investors are "less forgiving" of tech companies promising huge future returns than they were even months ago, he added.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic's debt picture is also unclear given it has a huge amount of accounting charges related to certain forms of investment.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: "As a result, investors do not yet have a clear view of Anthropic's underlying profitability or whether its rate of cash generation is sufficient to support the business as it scales," Hooper added.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Despite losing money, Anthropic has heaps of cash lying about.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: At $131.6bn, almost all of its cash in hand is defined as "working capital", meaning it can use the money to fund its operations day-to-day.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Currently, Anthropic has more cash on hand than Meta and Google combined.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic's costs could rise as it faces fierce competition for top staff and computing power from other AI giants.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: The leasing of data centres alone is costing the company $321.4bn so far this year.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Hooper said such large costs are expected to grow.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Even with this kind of cash, it won't be enough to maintain its business growth.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Any investors in Anthropic "will be paying for future dominance, not present-day economics", he said.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic sees boundless ways it can sell its technology to customers.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: A large portion of its current business comes from just 250 major enterprise customers, which it says have paid it at least $10mn in the past year.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: An even smaller number, just five enterprise customers, make up a quarter of its current business.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Michael Monaghan, portfolio manager of Founder ETF, pointed out that "many top Anthropic customers have no long-term contract".
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: The company's level of business concentration leaves Anthropic dependent on a small fraction of its paying customers to support its growth, with no guarantee it will continue.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic also has enterprise relationships with the likes of Google and Amazon, both of which are also investors in the company "and competitors", creating potential business conflicts in the future, Monaghan noted.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic said its overall enterprise customer base has grown rapidly, going from roughly 1,500 customers last year to almost 12,000 this year.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Part of its growth strategy is offering Claude tools for free before working to "convert these users into paying customers over time".
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: The strategy has led to Claude seeing "the fastest enterprise adoption of any technology in history", the company claimed.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: For all of the risks Anthropic has said AI poses, it also reiterated its claim AI will produce an "extraordinary" amount of good.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: "Achieving our mission means the world gains the enormous benefits of frontier AI while mitigating the most significant risks," the company said.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: That mission is defined as: "The responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity." "We do not pursue projects based on commercial opportunity or research novelty alone; our efforts must advance our mission.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: " Such hypothetical benefits include progress in healthcare, like the development of bespoke treatments for illnesses and improved disease detection, tailored education and legal advice and making more efficient power grids and batteries.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Decades of scientific progress could be condensed into years, accelerating drug discovery, disease detection, and the delivery of personalized therapy.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Anthropic said AI could provide individually tailored education and expert financial and legal advice, advance power grids and battery design for greater efficiency and reliability and help the "developing world" build more technological capabilities.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: "Ultimately, we believe frontier AI will help drive global economic growth," the company said.
sentences.article_title: Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know

sentences.text: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing Until a few years ago many of us may have been blissfully unaware of what a data centre was.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: These giant, warehouse-like buildings power virtually all our internet activity, from our web searches and emails to movie downloads and online banking.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: They are at the heart of the AI boom, housing the advanced computer chips and servers needed to run services like ChatGPT and Claude.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: But the speed at which they're growing, the enormous amount of electricity they consume and concerns about their environmental impact are fuelling a public backlash around the world.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: In the US, they've become a huge issue ahead of the midterm elections on 3 November, with both Republicans and opposition Democrats coming out against their development.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: It's putting opponents of data centre expansion on a collision course with US President Donald Trump, who has dismissed the pushback as a "sick conspiracy", even as public anger grows.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Here's what you need to know about the data centre boom, and why opposition is growing.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: There are about 12,250 data centres around the world, according to Data Center Map , external , a company that tracks both operational and pre-operational sites.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: That's up sharply from 2021, when there were around 8,000 , external operational sites.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: As the chart below shows, data centres are most densely clustered in the US which has 4,767 sites.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: It is followed by Europe, where the UK and Germany lead.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Data centres have typically been located near to cities where it's easier to access high voltage power lines or water resources for cooling.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: But as they get bigger, more are being built in rural areas.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: But when it comes to actual capacity, the US is ahead by a much larger margin, with China in second place and Europe lagging far behind.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: This gap is set to widen in the coming years, leading some to warn Europe risks missing out on the potential economic benefits of the AI boom , external .
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Data centres vary wildly in size, ranging from ones that fit inside a garden shed to others covering vast expanses of land.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: The world's largest operational data centre is widely reported to be one run by China Telecom in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, covering an area of approximately one million square metres (10.7 million sq ft).
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: That is equivalent to about 140 Fifa football pitches.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: However, much larger sites are under construction as the graphic below shows.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: All these sites are being built exclusively to provide the immense computing power needed to run AI services.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: For instance, Colossus 2, which is part of the wider Colossus campus, will house hundreds of thousands of advanced AI chips made by tech giant Nvidia.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: It will also be used to train xAI's chatbot Grok.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Elon Musk's company will use 41 methane gas turbines to help power the site, which activists say could "significantly increase" local air pollution , external .
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Local regulators say the turbines will meet air quality standards.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: The pressure data centres put on local resources has sparked increasing concern.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: These facilities can use significant amounts of water to cool their systems, which could lead to water shortages , some experts say.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Data centres worldwide are also thought to consume more electricity than the whole of France, as the chart below shows.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: This growing hunger for power is driving up carbon emissions, analysis shows , while putting pressure on local grids, which some fear could push up energy prices .
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: With others worried about the noise data centres make and the space they take up, a public backlash is gathering steam.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Some 16 US states have proposed laws to ban or temporarily block new facilities, and it could be a key issue in November's midterm elections .
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Outside the US, opposition to data centres has emerged in countries like Mexico , France, Indonesia and the UK .
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: But supporters say data centres are critical to national security , and the development of AI.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: They also say they are good for the economy , external , attracting investment, generating tax revenue and creating jobs in areas like construction.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: A recent report by the Brookings Center , external suggests data centres do create local jobs, although fewer than industry advocates claim.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: The type of data centre matters too.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: So-called hyperscale facilities - massive sites owned and run by tech giants like Amazon and Microsoft - have a bigger positive effect on jobs, it found.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: But "colocation" facilities, which lease space to remote tenants without a local presence, brought fewer benefits.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: As the debate over their merits intensifies, the data centre rollout continues.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: This year, the tech industry is expected to spend a combined $765bn , external ($544bn) on AI infrastructure in 2026, with this topping $1tn next year.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: But as concerns about the environmental impact grow, the tech industry is exploring alternatives.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: One idea is to put data centres in space , external or on the Moon , where they could harness abundant solar energy.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

sentences.text: Others predict that more AI processing could eventually be carried out by the hardware already inside our computers and smartphones , reducing the need for vast data centres altogether.
sentences.article_title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing
